info.title: Social Security beneficiaries by state (SSA): retirement, survivors and disability, counts and monthly amounts, December 2025: data API
info.summary: Static, read-only JSON and CSV files. No key, no sign-up. CORS open.
info.description:
Social Security beneficiaries by state (SSA): retirement, survivors and disability, counts and monthly amounts, December 2025: The Social Security Administration's counts and monthly benefit amounts of OASDI beneficiaries by state, DC and five territories, by type of benefit: retired workers and their spouses and children, survivors, and disabled workers and their spouses and children, with the number aged 65 or older by sex. Average benefits are computed from SSA's own counts and amounts.

Probative is a marketing firm, not a law firm; not legal advice. Every JSON response starts with a "meta" object holding the credit line, citation, DOI and license (CC BY 4.0).
